'''''Two-for-One''''' was a [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[reclamation cruiser]], part of the [[Squib Reclamation Fleet]]. [[Macemillian-winduarté]] was the [[Assistant-Deputy-Lieutenant-in-Chief-in-charge-of-Bartending]] on the cruiser, until he got left behind during a stopover on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Spare Parts">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref>
